wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-01/08 seats Plato entire, fetched commit-pinned from Perseus (tlg0059, Burnet's Oxford Classical Text): thirty-six works normalized to 8,203 Stephanus-referenced sections, with the Euthyphro taken from the grc1 file where no grc2 exists upstream, a substitution recorded in the source manifest. Verification lands on the Attic side of the reception: Phaedrus 251a–b, the seizure at the sight of beauty with its heat and sweat, and Symposium 215e, Alcibiades's leaping heart before the played instrument — the two loci where the fourth-century philosophical channel carries the somatic apparatus.
